executive_summary: Collection window November 9-15, 2027. The Bogota/Sao Paulo waist-tailoring thread produced one new development this window: businessoffashion.com published interviews with two of the original Bogota-showcase designers in which both describe the boned-waistband-over-shirting construction as a deliberate design decision developed over several seasons, made independently of the Sao Paulo designers and predating any editorial or retail coverage of the pattern. This is the first designer-sourced statement of intent in this thread -- distinct in kind from Inexmoda's original institutional program note, FFW's and Dieworkwear's editorial/critical readings, and SSENSE's retail buy, none of which previously carried a direct designer account of intent. It is logged as its own signal_id rather than folded into bogota-waist-tailoring-resort28-institutional, since the claim (designer intent, reported via a second editorial outlet) is a different claim shape than the original institutional program listing. No new retail, institutional, or social development occurred on either the Bogota or Sao Paulo threads this window. The Margiela raw-edge thread remains closed out as of 2027-10-18. Met Gala 2027, Wales Bonner, and CFDA's Fashion Fund/Awards remain untracked going forward per standing convention.

top_signals.name: BoF interview: Bogota designers describe waist-tailoring construction as deliberate multi-season design intent, not a trend response
top_signals.evidence: businessoffashion.com published interviews this window with two of the Bogota designers originally featured in Inexmoda's resort 2028 program note (2027-10-18). Both designers state the boned-waistband-over-shirting construction was developed across several prior seasons in their own ateliers and was not a response to any trend brief, retail request, or other designer's work; neither designer references the Sao Paulo echo or was aware of it before the interview. The piece is framed by BoF as reporting the designers' own account, not as BoF's independent reading of a pattern.
top_signals.index_note: Logged as a new signal_id (bogota-waist-tailoring-designer-intent-bof) distinct from bogota-waist-tailoring-resort28-institutional, -sao-paulo-echo, -sao-paulo-retail-buy, and -independent-criticism-synthesis: this is the first designer-sourced statement of intent in the thread, a different claim type than Inexmoda's institutional program listing, FFW's or Dieworkwear's editorial/critical readings, or SSENSE's retail buy. Origin classification is designer_originated, not editorial_amplified, because the primary claim being reported is the designers' own stated intent; BoF is the reporting outlet (source_sectors: editorial) but is not the origin of the claim. This keeps designer intent, editorial interpretation, and retail adoption distinct within the same thread rather than collapsing them under one classification.
top_signals.human_editor_note: derive_confidence() adopted as-is (medium): source_corroboration_count=1 from 'editorial' (businessoffashion.com), which is in HIGH_RELIABILITY_SECTORS, so the single-source medium exception applies. This is genuine independent reporting -- BoF conducted its own interviews and cites no other outlet's prior coverage as its source -- unlike the 2027-11-08 Dieworkwear synthesis, which was manually held below its derived tier because it cited no new sourcing. No such override is warranted here: the interview is primary reporting, not a rehash, so the formula's medium output is adopted without adjustment. Not upgraded to high, since only one outlet has obtained designer comment and no second source (institutional, retail, or a second editorial outlet) has corroborated the designers' account independently.

limitations: The designer-intent account rests on a single outlet's interviews with two designers; no second editorial outlet, institutional source, or the designers' own first-party channels have independently corroborated the account as of this window.

This report does not treat the designers' stated intent as evidence about the Sao Paulo echo's origin; both threads remain logged as separate signal_ids and the designers explicitly stated no awareness of the Sao Paulo pattern.
No new retail, institutional, or social development occurred on the Bogota or Sao Paulo threads this window beyond the item logged here.
